desc: Derive and prove the Ferrers/down-set characterization and translate fixed colors into a dominance condition.
Develop an \(O(M\log M)\) algorithm to detect whether any white cell is northwest of a black cell.
Handle edge cases, including empty/full shapes, \(N=1\), sparse coordinates, and same-row/column contradictions.
Implement the algorithm in Python with fast input and verify all samples and stress patterns.
